detailed_descriptions.en: Mythic Love: Iberian Legends is a fun monster romance visual novel inspired by Spanish myths and legends! Flirt with Iberian folklore creatures, save (or doom) humanity, and, if you earn their trust, unlock their true monstrous form! Meet five romanceable myths, each with their own drama, secrets, and a tendency to snack on humans from time to time ;). Your choices decide whether you end up in love, betrayed, or just… obliterated. Features: Five romanceable Iberian legends – from mischievous gods to broody monsters. Flirt at your own risk. Unlock their true monster forms – if they trust you enough. 30+ endings – happy, tragic, weird… and a few you’ll probably regret. Choices that matter – decide who to trust, who to love, and whether humanity survives your love life. 20+ hours of story content – A 300,000-word adventure with five romance routes, each offering around 4 hours of story content.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Mythic Love: Iberian Legends is a fun monster romance visual novel inspired by Spanish myths and legends! Flirt with Iberian folklore creatures, save (or doom) humanity, and, if you earn their trust, unlock their true monstrous form!

Meet five romanceable myths, each with their own drama, secrets, and a tendency to snack on humans from time to time ;). Your choices decide whether you end up in love, betrayed, or just… obliterated.

Features:

  • Five romanceable Iberian legends – from mischievous gods to broody monsters. Flirt at your own risk.

  • Unlock their true monster forms – if they trust you enough.

  • 30+ endings – happy, tragic, weird… and a few you’ll probably regret.

  • Choices that matter – decide who to trust, who to love, and whether humanity survives your love life.

  • 20+ hours of story content – A 300,000-word adventure with five romance routes, each offering around 4 hours of story content.
